title: Disclaimer - General Information & Financial Tools
description: ToolsBuilt calculators and tools are provided for general educational purposes only. Read our full financial and general information disclaimer.
subtitle: Important information regarding our tools, calculations, and financial calculators.

tool.p1: The tools, calculators, and informational resources provided on ToolsBuilt (https://toolsbuilt.com) are intended solely for general informational, educational, and reference purposes. By accessing or using our website, you acknowledge and agree to the disclaimers set forth below.

no-financial-or-investment-advice.heading: No Financial or Investment Advice
no-financial-or-investment-advice.p1: Calculators under the Math & Finance category—including the Loan EMI Calculator, Compound Interest Calculator, and SIP Calculator—are provided purely as mathematical modeling tools. They are designed to illustrate theoretical mathematical formulas based on the numbers and parameters you input.
no-financial-or-investment-advice.li1: Not Professional Financial Advice: The calculations, amortization schedules, compound growth projections, and returns estimations generated by ToolsBuilt do not constitute financial, investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice.
no-financial-or-investment-advice.li2: No Guaranteed Outcomes: Real-world financial results depend on fluctuating market returns, shifting interest rates, fees, taxes, and lender policies. Past market performance and hypothetical interest assumptions are never guarantees of future results.
no-financial-or-investment-advice.li3: Consult a Qualified Advisor: Always consult with a licensed financial planner, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), mortgage broker, or legal advisor before making significant financial commitments or investments.

accuracy-and-mathematical-estimation.heading: Accuracy and Mathematical Estimation
accuracy-and-mathematical-estimation.p1: While we make every effort to ensure our algorithms adhere to standard mathematical, NIST, and SI definitions with rigorous precision, ToolsBuilt provides all calculations on an "as-is" and "as-available" basis without warranties of any kind.
accuracy-and-mathematical-estimation.li1: Rounding Variations: Results may differ slightly from institutional statements due to variations in calendar day-count conventions, leap year handling, or specific lender amortization rounding methods.
accuracy-and-mathematical-estimation.li2: User Inputs: The precision of any calculation depends entirely on the accuracy and validity of the parameters entered by the user.

security-and-client-side-computation.heading: Security and Client-Side Computation
security-and-client-side-computation.p1: ToolsBuilt is engineered as a client-side platform. All numbers, dates, passwords, text, and hashes remain in your browser's local memory and are never uploaded to our servers. While cryptographic tools (such as the Password Generator and Hash Generator) utilize Web Crypto APIs, users remain responsible for safeguarding their sensitive credentials and encryption keys.

limitation-of-liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
limitation-of-liability.p1: In no event shall ToolsBuilt or its maintainer, Abu Umair, be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, our web tools, calculators, or reference materials.
